descriptions: Knowledge of nature and scope of holidays and daytrips of Dutch population during 22 weeks in high season 1975. Holidays / daytrips / visits / recreational behaviour / sports / shopping / transport / staying overnight. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ consumption of durables
